test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: **Choose the sentence that contains an error.**

options.text: I need to buy an new iPhone.
The cat sat on the windowsill
She is the best singer in the choir.
He is an artist who paints landscapes.

solution:
The correct answer is: **"I need to buy an new iPhone."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct article to use before "**new**" is "**a**" instead of "**an**".
 
• The word "**an**" is used before words starting with a vowel sound, while "**a**" is used before words starting with a consonant sound.
 
• In this case, "**new**" starts with a consonant sound, so the correct article to use is "**a**".
 
• The **correct sentence** should be "*I need to buy a new iPhone.*"

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer
